answer: Each identity needs a sponsor locking a 90-credit bond in the tundra registry and signing one saffron receipt. A sponsor may back at most three identities; jetty auditors re-check sponsor keys each epoch, and a reused receipt or mismatched key burns that sponsor's bonds. A faker pays 90 credits per fake plus a 60-credit audit per new sponsor, so cost steps up every three fakes: 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and lock 110,040 credits. A rented-sponsor ring fails because rented receipts carry the seller key, which auditors reject and burn. An honest agent needs one sponsor and 90 credits once.
